breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.value: landscape and width >= 600dp (bay beside a side pane)

breakpoints.name: split

breakpoints.name: card-stack

components.name: Done Button
components.description: The one clear primary action per habit; also Buy, Save, Add.
components.css: .ds-btn-done { font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; background: #6EE787; color: #06281A; height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-btn-done:disabled { background: #1C3A34; color: #9EB3AC; }

components.name: Menu Button
components.description: A 44dp outlined circle beside Done; its menu holds Skip, Fail, take back, Edit and Delete.
components.css: .ds-btn-menu { font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #24443E; color: #CFE3DE; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The container for habits, form groups, history items and calendars.
components.css: .ds-card { font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; background: #152220; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; color: #E6F2EE; }

components.name: Segments
components.description: A pill of choices whose selection slides on a spring.
components.css: .ds-seg { font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; display: flex; border: 1px solid #24443E; border-radius: 22px; padding: 3px; } .ds-seg span { flex: 1; text-align: center; padding: 10px 8px; color: #9EB3AC; border-radius: 20px; } .ds-seg .on { background: #1C3A34; color: #E6F2EE; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #CFE3DE; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A faint fill and a ready-green outline when focused.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; color: #E6F2EE; } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: #6EE787; }

components.name: Bottom Bar
components.description: Lab, Shop, Habits, Diary at the foot of every window; never a side rail.
components.css: .ds-bar { font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; display: flex; background: #081313; height: 60px; } .ds-bar a { flex: 1; text-align: center; color: #9EB3AC; font-size: 13px; } .ds-bar .on { color: #E6F2EE; }

components.name: Bolt Slots
components.description: Driven head, dashed ring, sheared head, open hole: each slot state its own form.
components.css: .ds-bolt { display: inline-block; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #9EB3AC; background: #081313; margin: 3px; } .ds-bolt.done { background: #CFE3DE; border-color: #6C8F87; } .ds-bolt.skip { background: transparent; border-style: dashed; } .ds-bolt.fail { background: #FF7457; border-color: #FF7457; }

components.name: Gauge
components.description: A glow-to-steel fill on an edge track with a soft halo and a bright leading spark.
components.css: .ds-gauge { height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #24443E; } .ds-gauge i { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #A6FF4D, #CFE3DE); box-shadow: 0 0 10px #A6FF4D66; }

components.name: Snackbar
components.description: After every log and purchase, with Undo.
components.css: .ds-snack { font-family: Lexend, sans-serif; background: #1C3A34; color: #E6F2EE; border-radius: 4px; padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-snack button { background: none; border: none; color: #6EE787; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
A robot's workbench after dark. The app is a deep greenhouse-teal lab in which the robot stands on its round platform beside a steel bench. Under the bench a glass fusion capsule powers it all; its uranium-green light and the light rail it feeds hang over the bench and brighten as the Core attribute rises. Every habit running today is a steel frame clamped upright on the bench and every slot is a bolt hole in it: Done drives a bolt home, Skip leaves a dashed ring, Fail shears the bolt, and an open slot is an empty tapped hole. A habit with every bolt in goes critical: its frame glows uranium green and positrons rise off it. Uranium green is light, not paint; the interface itself stays teal, cool steel and frost, with ready green as the one live colour.

Content sits on cards: every habit, form group, history item and calendar is a card one step above the ground. The bolt is the single ornament and always carries meaning: the slot, the day, the five hex holes of the diary page's gauge. The diary page's emblem is an atom, three orbits round a nucleus.

Density is compact and calm: 44dp controls, 28dp gutters on wide windows, one clear Done per habit with everything else in its menu. One rounded, open face (Lexend) carries everything.
keyCharacteristics: Greenhouse-teal ground with a deeper rail; content on cards; tonal steps, no shadows.
One live accent (ready green); gold for nuts, coral for failure, cool steel for selection, metal and driven bolts.
Uranium glow as the only light: the reactor, its rail, the gauges, a critical frame.
Lexend throughout: bold display, semibold titles, tracked small caps for labels.
Bolts and frames as the one ornament and the one state language.
Robot-grammar line icons: 24dp, 1.8 stroke, square caps, pivot-joint circles.
Synthesized sound for the moments that change something.

rules.name: The Ready Or Pressable Rule
rules.body: Ready green appears only where something can be pressed or marks where the owner is (plus the starter robot's eyes, smile and platform ring; painted parts carry their finish's own eye colour). Selection that is not a place is cool steel.

rules.name: The Light Is Light Rule
rules.body: Uranium green is light, not paint: it glows (the reactor, the rail, gauges, completed work) and never fills a control, a label or text.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Gold is nuts, coral is failed or destructive. Neither decorates, warns generally, or adds variety.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Lexend sets everything, including the printed diary template. Contrast comes from weight (400 to 700), size and tracked caps, never from a second family.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every count and balance uses Numeral with tabular figures so numbers hold still as they change.

rules.name: The Content On Cards Rule
rules.body: Habits, form groups, history items and calendars sit on cards (12dp corners, 16dp inside, the card surface and a white-8% border). The bay is framed, not carded. Nothing nests a card in a card.

dos: Do give each habit exactly one ready-green Done pill and put Skip, Fail, take back, Edit and Delete in its menu.
Do show every slot state with its own bolt form (driven, dashed, sheared, open hole) so state never depends on colour alone.
Do set every screen in Lexend, counts and balances in Numeral with tabular figures.
Do put content on cards one tonal step above the ground, and lift surfaces by tone instead of shadows.
Do keep uranium green as light: the reactor, the rail, gauges, completed work.
Do show selection in cool steel and offer Undo in the snackbar after every log and purchase.
Do keep the diary page on the owner's papers and inks, ruled lines only, with the atom emblem.
donts: Don't use ready green for decoration, emphasis or non-place selection; it means pressable or here.
Don't paint a control, label or text uranium green.
Don't use coral for anything but failure and destruction, or gold for anything but nuts.
Don't nest cards, or build the dark-dashboard default of glowing stat tiles and progress rings.
Don't add ornaments beyond bolts, frames and the atom, or bring back plants.
Don't put squared or grid paper anywhere; calendars use ruled rows, the diary ruled lines.
Don't draw icons outside the robot grammar or substitute glyphs and emoji for them.
